business_summary: Richinfo Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the development and sales of software products in China. The company offers Rich AICloud, an enterprise-grade cloud computing solution for AI-native scenarios; Rich AIBox, an enterprise-level intelligent agent development and operation platform; Rich Agent, an application capability matrix; RichBoost, a training and inference acceleration platform targeting AI scenarios, such as large language models, text-to-image processing, and video generation; RichMoss, an ultra-large-scale computing cluster management platform; and RichNet, an AI-native cloud computing architecture. It also provides collaborative office products, including domestic IT email, AI-powered intelligent email assistant, and mobile office platform; smart channel products comprising 5G messaging CSP platform, intelligent outbound calling system, mobile application cloud development platform, digital human platform, unified search platform, rights center platform, private domain traffic operation platform, and mobile phone service hall; and intelligent computing services and data intelligence products, such as AI-native cloud computing solutions, smart cloud drive, one-click cloud migration tool, multi-cloud management platform, big data platform, and terminal management platform. In addition, the company offers solutions for telecom, energy, financial, party and government, cultural tourism, construction, and transportation industries. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Richinfo Technology Limited and changed its name to Richinfo Technology Co., Ltd. in June 2016. Richinfo Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
